milestones.outcome: The composed fallback course sends its unchanged public gesture only on current admissible input and passes normal native verification without changing product guards or budgets.
exit_criteria: A bounded fixture-only readiness wait precedes the same off-hunk gesture; original budgets, verdict/provider sequence and product guards are unchanged; temporary instrumentation is absent.
The independently reviewed142-file binding and final uninstrumented affected build/original registered native courses and tooling/preflight pass; all negatives and provenance are retained.
Focused gates and latest authoritative main integration pass; exact source/runtime/ownership and remaining frozen release obligations are handed back.
milestones.boundary: Existing round-trip fixture input readiness and useful failure facts, corresponding source binding, focused evidence and docs/card. No product policy, replay/extra gesture, budget/assertion relaxation, projection acceptance or release publication.
